preconditions.description: The number of notes n is between 1 and 100,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(1 <= x <= 200000 for x in a)
preconditions.description: The input sequence a contains exactly n integers, each between 1 and 200,000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip() == '-1' or (len(b) == n and all(1 <= x <= 5 for x in b) and all((a[i] < a[i+1] and b[i] < b[i+1]) or (a[i] > a[i+1] and b[i] > b[i+1]) or (a[i] == a[i+1] and b[i] != b[i+1]) for i in range(n-1)))
postconditions.description: If no valid fingering exists, output is '-1'. Otherwise, output is a sequence b of n integers between 1 and 5 such that for every adjacent pair, the finger relationship matches the note relationship: strictly increasing notes require strictly increasing fingers, strictly decreasing notes require strictly decreasing fingers, and equal notes require different fingers.
